Oil price forecasting: out-of-sample evaluation

Models estimated only on data up to 2024-12-31 (no refitting since), then applied day by day from 2025-01-02 to 2026-10-29 (462 forecast dates). Benchmarks: no change, historical mean, direct AR (also estimated on data up to the cutoff). Window and weight choices come from the notebooks' own 2022-2023 validation; some design decisions were made after seeing later data, so the test is clean for estimation but not pristine. This is a deliberately stale test model (skill plus ageing). Generated 2026-10-30.
